sources.title: llm-d
sources.snippet: llm-d is an open-source, Kubernetes-native stack for distributed LLM inference. It runs vLLM, SGLang, and more across your cluster, turning single-node engines into production-grade serving on the hardware you already have.

sources.title: LLM Sensitivity Evaluation Framework for Clinical Diagnosis
sources.snippet: However, for clinical diagnosis, higher expectations are required for LLM's reliability and sensitivity: thinking like physicians and remaining sensitive to key medical information that affects diagnostic reasoning, as subtle variations can lead to different diagnosis results.
